stem.text: Which description of movement in phloem is correct?

A.text: Adding sucrose to a sieve tube element increases its water potential so that water enters and increases the hydrostatic pressure.

B.text: At a sink, such as a storage organ, sucrose is removed from a sieve tube element and polymerised into starch.

C.text: At a source, such as a photosynthesising leaf, sucrose enters a sieve tube element by facilitated diffusion.

D.text: At a source, sucrose is loaded into a companion cell using a protein that carries both hydrogen ions and sucrose molecules.
